description: POST HOC, added after seeing the E3 results; not pre-registered and in no verdict. Held-out mistakes within a seen route: realizations in every violation x route cell are split into groups A and B (sorted by name, alternating); a monitor trained on one group across all four routes is tested on the other group (held-out templates) and compared with the E3 all-four regime on the same test incidents (seen templates), with the same number of training incidents.

meta.sampling: every regime uses the E3 sampler: the same number of incidents, spread over route x violation x awareness cells

notes: templates = seen: the all-four regime, which trained on incidents from the tested realizations. templates = held_out: trained on the other group of realizations only. test_group = both pools the two folds (recall only; AUROC is not pooled across two classifiers). Thresholds are set on benign validation trajectories per fitted monitor, as in E3.
